hypothesis: 5m decision noise is the enemy: a lower-frequency decision clock on the SAME frozen calibrated v30 isotonic-4 scores may raise monthly expectancy. All repo work uses the base decision clock; thinned clocks are untried.
family: decision-clock thinning (lower-frequency) on frozen calibrated predictions

grid_discovery.note: The frozen frame holds 4076 rows on a perfectly regular 6-hourly grid (00/06/12/18 UTC, 4 rows/day x 1019 days, 2023-06-01 to 2026-03-15). The brief's '5m clock' label refers to the 5-minute base candle resolution; the actual decision clock is 6-hourly (stride 72, see tests/test_decision_clock.py). No 5-minute decision frame exists in this dataset.
grid_discovery.literal_1h_audit: Keeping the FIRST decision row of each UTC hour keeps 4076/4076 rows (identity): every row is alone in its hour. Asserted at runtime.
grid_discovery.literal_4h_audit: Keeping the FIRST decision row of each 4h block (00/04/08/12/16/20 UTC) keeps 4076/4076 rows (identity): hours 00/06/12/18 fall in distinct blocks 00/04/12/16. Asserted at runtime.
grid_discovery.consequence: Literal 1h/4h rules are vacuous on this grid, so the 1h/4h branch slots execute the nearest achievable lower-frequency thinnings (12-hourly and 24-hourly/daily) with frozen prediction vectors carried unchanged. This isolates the clock effect exactly as the hypothesis intends. Branch names keep the assigned {5m-control, 1h, 4h} labels; each branch records its actual_decision_grid.

5m-control.actual_decision_grid: 6h-full (all frozen rows; the base 6-hourly clock, mislabeled 5m in the brief)

1h.actual_decision_grid: 12h (00 and 12 UTC rows only; half decision rate)
1h.rule: keep rows with UTC hour in [0, 12]; each kept row carries its frozen calibrated prediction vector unchanged

4h.actual_decision_grid: 24h/daily (00 UTC rows only; quarter decision rate)
4h.rule: keep rows with UTC hour == 0; each kept row carries its frozen calibrated prediction vector unchanged

dd_guard.reference: 5m-control_1x run sampled equity (trade exit_time/equity_after), applied at each branch signal's own signal_time
dd_guard.cutoff: 1-microsecond (only exits strictly before the signal count; past-only, 100.0 seed)
dd_guard.caveat: trade-candle-close sampled equity, NOT mark-price or full intrabar drawdown

control_reproduction.on_mismatch: STOP: raise before running any other branch and report

causality: Thinning masks are pure functions of each row's own signal_time (UTC hour); every kept decision uses only past data. No refit of any kind: frozen calibrated vectors are carried unchanged. Fold structure (quarterly, 8-day embargo embodied in the frozen calibrators) is preserved: every fold retains coverage, logged per branch. Frequency policy (cooldown + monthly cap via swing_signals) and backtest chain are IDENTICAL on each subsampled frame.
notes: PRE-SPECIFIED matrix: 3 clocks x 2 sizings = 6 branches; 3 scenarios per branch (normal / fee_stress fee .00055 / execution_stress FillStress(5,5,5,.00055,False)). No matrix changes permitted after backtests. Exploratory on the opened 2023-2026 development interval only; NOT an independent test.
